status: Authored L/M/H sensitivity; unreviewed; no site-specific Vopak turn rate established

sources.title: Making Smart Energy Choices
sources.author: Tom Stone, Blackmer director of marketing, Pump Solutions Group
sources.finding: Manufacturer-authored article discusses historical one-turn/month operation and then targets of three to four monthly turns across liquid-storage terminals.
sources.limitation: Old promotional industry material covering diverse liquids and terminals; not empirical SA fuel-terminal calibration. Does not state our base value of two.

sources.title: UK Downstream Oil Infrastructure, Wood Mackenzie Final Report
sources.finding: Uses throughput divided by tank capacity as the turn measure; coastal and inland operating patterns differ. Receipt and dispatch facilities can constrain throughput.
sources.limitation: Method and operating context only; no numeric SA turnover benchmark.

inference: Use 1/2/3 monthly gross-capacity-equivalent turns as a deliberately simple authored sensitivity, with two as an interpolated base. These are not statistical confidence bounds or verified technical maxima.
capacity_basis: Apply to the existing partial gross site inventory, without assuming a fuel-compatible fraction. Outputs are gross handling equivalents, not assured petrol/diesel supply or spare capacity.
counting: One outbound volume per terminal; receipts plus dispatches would double count. Do not sum regional terminal handling as unique national sales: Durban-Lesedi transfers may appear at both sites.
vintage_limit: Reported 2022 petrol/diesel sales are historical context against inventory checked October 2026; this is not a matched-year adequacy test.
expiry_trigger: Replace at the first site-specific monthly dispatch/working-capacity review or before any capacity/investment recommendation
task: Obtain 12 months of unique outbound volume, compatible working capacity, tank occupancy, product split, downtime and berth/pipeline/road/rail limits for each page-15 site. Derive seasonal realised gross and working-capacity turns separately; retain leases as conditional.
